## Symptom and environment

Which behavior failed? Give the version or commit and relevant runtime or device.

## Reproduction

List the smallest input and steps that reproduce the problem. Include expected and observed behavior.

## Verification

How can a reviewer confirm the fix? Include the affected boundary and any realistic failure or retry case. Attach relevant evidence with private data removed.
